tool_input_args.value:
# Re-read the successfully retrieved content from the execution output
csv_raw = """deal_id,rep_name,region,product,amount,close_date,status
D001,James Okafor,North,Meridian Insights Pro,87500,2026-07-05,won
D002,Sofia Delgado,South,Meridian Insights Pro,62000,2026-07-08,won
D003,James Okafor,East,Meridian DataBridge,43000,2026-07-12,won
D004,Marcus Webb,West,Meridian Insights Lite,9500,2026-07-15,lost
D005,Sofia Delgado,North,Meridian DataBridge,55000,2026-07-19,won
D006,James Okafor,South,Meridian Insights Pro,120000,2026-07-22,won
D007,Marcus Webb,East,Meridian Insights Lite,7800,2026-07-28,pending
D008,Sofia Delgado,West,Meridian DataBridge,38000,2026-08-02,won
D009,James Okafor,North,Meridian Insights Pro,95000,2026-08-05,won
D010,Sofia Delgado,East,Meridian Insights Pro,74000,2026-08-09,won
D011,Marcus Webb,South,Meridian Insights Lite,12000,2026-08-11,lost
D012,James Okafor,West,Meridian DataBridge,66000,2026-08-14,won
D013,Sofia Delgado,North,Meridian Insights Pro,105000,2026-08-18,pending
D014,Marcus Webb,East,Meridian Insights Lite,8500,2026-08-21,won
D015,James Okafor,South,Meridian Insights Pro,88000,2026-08-25,won
D016,Sofia Delgado,West,Meridian DataBridge,47000,2026-08-28,lost
D017,James Okafor,North,Meridian DataBridge,72000,2026-09-02,won
D018,Marcus Webb,East,Meridian Insights Lite,5500,2026-09-04,pending
D019,Sofia Delgado,South,Meridian Insights Pro,198000,2026-09-05,won
D020,James Okafor,West,Meridian Insights Pro,115000,2026-09-06,pending
D021,Sofia Delgado,North,Meridian DataBridge,33000,2026-09-07,won
D022,Marcus Webb,South,Meridian Insights Lite,11000,2026-09-07,pending"""

lines = csv_raw.strip().split('\n')
headers = [h.strip() for h in lines[0].split(',')]

target_reps = {"James Okafor", "Sofia Delgado"}
target_deals = {"D001", "D002", "D003", "D005", "D006", "D008"}

matching_rows = []
for line in lines[1:]:
    cols = [c.strip() for c in line.split(',')]
    row = {headers[i]: cols[i] for i in range(len(headers))}
    
    deal_id = row.get("deal_id", "")
    rep_name = row.get("rep_name", "")
    status = row.get("status", "")
    
    if deal_id in target_deals and rep_name in target_reps and status.lower() == "won":
        matching_rows.append(row)

print(f"Found {len(matching_rows)} matching won deals:\n")
for r in matching_rows:
    print(f"Deal: {r['deal_id']}  |  Rep: {r['rep_name']}  |  Product: {r['product']}  |  Amount: ${int(r['amount']):,}  |  Close Date: {r['close_date']}  |  Status: {r['status']}")

# Totals by rep
james_total = sum(int(r['amount']) for r in matching_rows if r['rep_name'] == 'James Okafor')
sofia_total = sum(int(r['amount']) for r in matching_rows if r['rep_name'] == 'Sofia Delgado')
print(f"\nJames Okafor total: ${james_total:,}")
print(f"Sofia Delgado total: ${sofia_total:,}")
print(f"Combined total: ${james_total + sofia_total:,}")
